jdf.why: The kraj numbers each contract area's licences with its own prefix: 912 Havířovsko (I and II), 873 Karvinsko, 874 Orlovsko (871 Českotěšínsko, 863 Frýdecko-Místecko, 904 Hlučínsko). Checked against the live map: the 912 lines run from provozovna Havířov with 42-/43- buses, 873 from Karviná with 52-, 874 from Orlová with 51-; the register notes name the same areas ('provozní oblast Karvinsko' …). The ODIS line number is the last three digits; one ODIS line can hold licences of two areas (553: 873553 + 874553), so trips are merged by ODIS number.

365.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Dobrá, Horní and Dolní Domaslavice, Soběšovice and Žermanice: 9 stops no other line serves. It runs only about every 80–90 min, at no fixed minute: from Frýdek-Místek 13:40 (to Žermanice), 15:00, 16:30, 17:50; back 14:05, 15:00, 16:45, 17:24. Checked by hand on 25 Oct 2026 (Step 4, method-check-2026-10-25.md): every 90 (15:00 / 16:30 both ways) left the 16:30 slot from Podlesí without a trip, so every 80: Frýdek-Místek 16:30 (17:50 and 9:50 exact as well), Podlesí 16:45 (14:05 exact as well). Off the pattern: Frýdek-Místek 15:00 (10 min); Podlesí 12:25, 15:00, 17:24. The buses rotate between 365–369 at both ends.

366.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Dobrá, Lučina and Žermanice. About hourly, at no fixed minute: out 13:20, 14:30, 15:10, 16:10, 16:58, 18:58; towards Frýdek-Místek at Žermanice 12:36, 13:47, 14:31 (these start there), 15:41, 16:36 (from Podlesí 15:30, 16:25). The line is read at Žermanice, rozcestí, so the short trips that turn or start there count. Checked by hand on 25 Oct 2026 (Step 4, method-check-2026-10-25.md): every 60 at :10 / :25 left 17:10 and 17:25 without a trip, and no hourly minute fits both 16:10 and 16:58. So every 120 with two slots each way, exact in the model hour: Frýdek-Místek 16:10 and 16:58, Podlesí 15:30 and 16:25 (Žermanice 15:41, 16:36). It needs 3 buses, one more than before (on the owner checks). Off the pattern: out 12:35, 13:20, 14:30, 15:10; the Žermanice starts 13:47 and 14:31.

367.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, Bruzovice and Žermanice: 3 trips each way in the afternoon. Every 180 with one bus: Frýdek-Místek 16:35 exact (the 13:35 slot stands for 13:25), Podlesí 15:40 exact. The way back runs on the Lučina path (Bruzovice, Zámostí – Pazderna – Lučina), as the evening trips do, so Zámostí, which only those serve, is on a line.

368.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, direct: 3 trips a day each way, 170–180 min apart in the afternoon. Every 180 with one bus: Frýdek-Místek 15:30 (12:40 is 10 min after its 12:30 slot), Podlesí 13:35 and 16:35 exact (16:35 is the 16:22 trip from Havířov, Město passing Podlesí, Těšínská). Checked by hand on 25 Oct 2026 (Step 4, method-check-2026-10-25.md): the 15:40 slot had no trip; the model hour's 15:30 wins over 12:40. It is the only line at Bruzovice, Kunčický and Bruzovice, kříž.

369.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, Kaňovice and Šenov. Hourly most of the day at its core points: Frýdek-Místek :30, and towards Frýdek-Místek Havířov, Město, železniční stanice :57 (8:57–18:57). Half the trips end at Město, the rest go on to Podlesí, so the Simutrans line runs to Podlesí. In the afternoon the timetable shifts: out 14:45 and 15:40, back from Podlesí 14:10, 14:40, 15:40. Checked by hand on 25 Oct 2026 (Step 4, method-check-2026-10-25.md): model hour set by hand to 16:00. Its busiest stretch, 14:10–16:10 (6 departures against 4 at 15:00–17:00), counts the 14:25 Frýdek-Místek, Frýdek – Kaňovice short, whose stops are all on 369; without it the line stays at 16:00 (5 against 4), as 282 on the Opavsko sheet. No hourly row fits 15:30–17:30 (both 15:40 departures), so every 120 with two slots each way, exact: Frýdek-Místek 15:40 and 16:30, Podlesí 15:40 and 16:45 (Město 15:52, 16:57). It repeats as 12:30, 13:40, 14:30, 15:40, 16:30, 17:40, 18:30 out and 12:45, 13:40, 14:45, 15:40, 16:45, 17:40, 18:45 back. Off the pattern: out 13:30 and 17:30 (10 min), 14:45 (15); back 14:10 (30), 14:40 and 17:45 (5). The knot check towards Havířov shows 2–3 h: it compares with the few trips that run on to Podlesí, while the afternoon trips end at Město.

451.note: Havířov – Orlová, Lutyně, every 30 all day: Podlesí :00 / :30, Lutyně :16 / :46 (:18 / :48 after 17:00). It is modelled at 16:00. In that hour 451 itself has no 17:00 from Podlesí and no 16:46 from Lutyně: 452 runs those two departures (17:00, 16:48) by its path via Prostřední Suchá. So the trunk is read with 452's trips (Step 5, as 503 in 504's slot). Checked by hand on 25 Oct 2026 (Step 4, method-check-2026-10-25.md): read alone, 451 left one model-hour slot each way without a trip. The Simutrans line runs all four slots on 451's path (running times 41 / 40 min, set by hand to 451's own), so the knot check at Havířov, Město shows 29–31 min for the two 452 slots, which do not pass there. 13:00–15:00 has extra shift trips (13:08, 13:20, 13:45, 14:15, 14:35); they are listed. Trips via Orlová, Město, náměstí run in the same slots, and that stop is on the town lines. The Elektrárna Dětmarovice trips are the power plant's shifts, so they become 451 Elektrárna, every 480: Elektrárna 14:10 (22:10, 6:10), Podlesí 12:45 (20:45, 4:45): the real 13:00 is a slot of the every-30 trunk, so the shift bus leaves 15 min earlier rather than together with a trunk bus. It is the only service of Dětmarovice, V polích.

These lines of the same areas stop at Ostrava, Hranečník and are on the Ostrava sheet (section All lines at Hranečník), with their buses. They are not repeated here.
